name: api-scenarios-canonical
description: An empty simulator under the api_scenarios profile, for a client that runs the generator's shared API scenarios (verification/scenarios/api.json, SHA-256 below): the root's metadata lookup is refused 422 bad-request/request-params-required and GET /folders/ lists the root, as that definition's namespace.open expects. Each scenario makes everything it uses in a folder of its own and deletes it. A client whose upload parts are larger than 1 MiB needs FILES_MOCK_MAX_BODY_BYTES at least as large.
